entities.name: PMID:10731501
observations: Human tracer study comparing oligomeric and monomeric silica with aluminum; study 1 included three healthy volunteers.

entities.name: Silica reduces Al availability
observations: In three healthy volunteers, 17 mg oligomeric silica reduced 26Al availability by 67% versus aluminum alone (P=0.01); 17 mg monomeric silica had no significant effect (P=0.40). Small sample limits certainty.
